```{=html}
<script>
// Open reveal decks in a new tab so site chrome / back-button hash nav don't fight Reveal
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  document.querySelectorAll('#listing-slides a[href]').forEach((a) => {
    a.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
    a.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener');
  });
});
</script>
```
